title: From Video Device
text: Capture live image data from image acquisition device, 3 outputs, {Data type} sets Video output data type; {Device} sets the image acquisition device, {Video format}, {Video source} sets the video input sources supported by device available video input, {Edit properties...} sets the video source properties, {Enable hardware triggering} sets the hardware-triggered acquisition, {ROI position} sets the region of interest in video image, {Output color space} sets the video output color, {Preview...} sets the preview of live video, {Block sample time} sets the block sampling rate, {Ports mode} sets the type of video output signal One multidimensional, {Read All Frames} sets the all available image frames captured and {Metadata Output Ports} sets the kinect ® for Windows ®. Values come from the instance.
